# phux

phux is a terminal multiplexer whose panes are a view. You, Cockpit, a script,
or an agent attach to the same live terminal. When a harness emits, blocked is
a fact on that wire. Join another machine with no phux account.

This file is the agent-oriented map of the site. Every page below is also
available as clean markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown` to any page URL.

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://phux.sh/install | sh        # phux CLI
curl -fsSL https://phux.sh/install-cockpit | sh # Cockpit (native GUI)
```

## Hosted services

- [MCP server](https://phux.sh/mcp): streamable-HTTP, read-only. Tools:
  `search_docs`, `get_page` (any page as markdown), `get_install_command`,
  `latest_release`. [Server card](https://phux.sh/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).
- [Agent skills](https://phux.sh/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json):
  `using-phux`, `using-phux-mcp`.
- Live browser demo: `wss://shell.phux.sh/session` (anonymous edge shell, or
  authenticate with GitHub/Google for a native Linux shell).

## Documentation (docs.phux.sh)

- [Overview](https://docs.phux.sh/overview): what phux is and when to use it.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.phux.sh/quickstart/install): install and first attach.
- [Concepts](https://docs.phux.sh/concepts): terminals as objects on a wire.
- [Consumers](https://docs.phux.sh/consumers): TUI, web, agents, scripts.
- [Wire protocol](https://docs.phux.sh/wire/proto): the L0/L1/L2/L3 protocol reference.
- [Architecture](https://docs.phux.sh/architecture): how the substrate fits together.
- [Decisions (ADRs)](https://docs.phux.sh/decisions): why the design is what it is.
